__I confirm that this assignment is my own work and that I have:__

Read and understood the guidance on plagiarism in the Student Handbook, including the University of Glasgow Statement on Plagiarism



Clearly referenced, in both the text and the bibliography or references, __all sources__ used in the work 



Fully referenced \(including page numbers\) and used inverted commas for __all text quoted__ from books, journals, web etc\. \(Please check with your School which referencing style is to be used\)

Not sought or used the services of any professional agencies to produce this work
